Fantasy trading-card illustration in the style of early-to-mid 1990s card art: hand-made traditional media (gouache, acrylic, watercolour and pen-and-ink), visible brushstrokes and pen lines, matte paper texture, and the slightly soft, faded look of a card printed in the 1990s. Expressive and a little stylised rather than realistic: strong shapes, bold silhouettes, sometimes inked outlines and flat patterned colour. Dark overall with near-black shadows, lit by bold, saturated accent colours taken from the card's own light and colour key (no default orange) where they matter. Frame the subject tightly: it fills most of the picture and may be cropped by the edges, with its face or focal point near the centre; keep the background minimal, simple and dark. Landscape 3:2 composition. No text, no letters, no border, no card frame, no logo, no watermark, no signature. Not photorealistic, not 3D render, not modern digital concept art, not anime.

Setting: Greek myth as told in Homer, Hesiod and the Greek tragedies, depicted faithfully to those stories: bronze armour, crested helmets, round aspis shields, linen chitons, black ships, the wine-dark Aegean sea, white limestone, temples, cypress, smoke and fire.

Presence: a terrifying, dominant presence that fills the frame. The subject fills most of the picture; keep the background minimal.

common.name: Common frame
common.prompt:
A blank, empty trading-card frame template for a card game based on the Odyssey and Greek myth, seen perfectly flat and straight-on, filling the whole image edge to edge, portrait orientation. Layout from top to bottom: a narrow horizontal title bar across the top with a round empty medallion at its right end; below it a large rectangular art window taking up about the upper half of the card, filled with solid flat pure black (#000000) with crisp straight edges; below that a thin horizontal type bar; below that a large empty rectangular text box of pale aged parchment; at the bottom right a small empty plaque overlapping the corner of the text box. The title bar, medallion, type bar, text box and plaque are completely blank. Style: a rustic, retro 1990s hand-painted trading-card frame, gouache and ink texture, worn and weathered like an old printed card, muted colours, matte with no glossy highlights, no glow, no light rays, no sky, symmetrical with clean edges. The wear is on the frame only; the black art window stays solid, untouched black.

Fantasy trading-card illustration in the style of early-to-mid 1990s card art: hand-made traditional media (gouache, acrylic, watercolour and pen-and-ink), visible brushstrokes and pen lines, matte paper texture, and the slightly soft, faded look of a card printed in the 1990s. Expressive and a little stylised rather than realistic: strong shapes, bold silhouettes, sometimes inked outlines and flat patterned colour. Dark overall with near-black shadows, lit by bold, saturated accent colours taken from the card's own light and colour key (no default orange) where they matter. Frame the subject tightly: it fills most of the picture and may be cropped by the edges, with its face or focal point near the centre; keep the background minimal, simple and dark. Landscape 3:2 composition. No text, no letters, no border, no card frame, no logo, no watermark, no signature. Not photorealistic, not 3D render, not modern digital concept art, not anime.

Norse look for this hero: the same 1990s hand-made card art, but colder and harder than the Greek cards. Heavier, rougher black ink lines with a carved, woodcut-like quality, as if cut into wood or stone; flat areas of colour broken by scratchy hatching. A northern palette of slate blue, iron grey, bone white and deep pine green, with sparing accents of blood red and dull, tarnished gold; no warm Mediterranean light, no sunsets, no bronze glow. Weather matters: snow, sleet, sea-spray, mist and long winter dusk. Where the picture shows objects, give them Viking Age ornament: interlaced beasts and knotwork carved on wood, iron and runestones in the Urnes and Mammen styles, and the look of the Gotland picture-stones. People are weathered and heavy, in wool, fur, leather and iron; no horned helmets, no winged helmets, no fantasy plate armour. Focus over scenery: the card's subject is the star of the picture and should look as striking and powerful as possible, large and unmistakable at a glance. The background is simple, atmospheric and secondary, and no second large figure or creature competes with the subject unless the card is about that creature.

Setting: Viking Age Norse myth: iron mail, round wooden shields, furs, runestones, longhalls, ravens, wolves, fjords, snow and northern sky.

A wide background illustration for the battle screen of a mythology card game, made by hand like a 1993 fantasy trading-card or game-book illustration: bold, wobbly black pen-and-ink outlines around every shape, filled with thin, flat, transparent watercolour and gouache washes. Big simple flat shapes of colour with almost no shading or modelling, a little ink cross-hatching in the shadows, blotchy uneven washes with hard dried edges, splatters and visible brush marks, and the rough off-white paper texture and grain clearly showing through the paint. Naive, slightly clumsy, decorative and stylised, like an old printed card with slightly faded, misregistered colour. A limited palette of 4 or 5 colours, dark overall. Absolutely not realistic: no realistic lighting, no glow, no soft gradients, no depth of field, no fine detail or texture rendering, no oil-painting look, no 3D, no digital painting, not modern concept art. Composition for a game board: low contrast, all the interesting shapes at the edges and in the bottom corners; the centre is a calm, empty, evenly dark area, because game cards sit on top of it. No figures or creatures in the centre. No text, no letters, no border, no frame, no logo, no signature.

Setting: the whirlpool of Charybdis from Homer's Odyssey: a low rock with a great gnarled fig tree at the far right, its roots gripping the stone; the edges of a vast spiralling whirlpool sweeping around the bottom and the left, with broken timbers, oars and a mast swirling in it; spray and mist rising; a dark sky with the faint arc of the strait's cliffs in the distance.
Colour: near-black deep blue to dark sea green (#06121a to #1d4a5a) with white spray and pale teal accents.
